issues.title: Paper-thin loft floor and apparent upstairs light bleed
issues.symptom: User observed apparent light from above on the under-loft ceiling.
issues.cause: The upper floor had one rendered face, no separate soffit/fascia or structural depth.
issues.action: Added a 160mm authored slab with physical collision, an independent underside and exposed edges; lowered the utility fitting to Y2.84 before grading.
issues.evidence: BlackpineDeckDepthTest fails against pre-fix compiled 4b2bb24: loft needs a real 160mm underside. It passes after correction, including actual triangle area/normals and upstairs circuit isolation. Before/after PNGs: development/levels/previews/defects/ and mill-lighting/.
issues.older_maps: Audit floor depth and cross-storey lighting in House, Farmhouse, School, Church and Castle; depth is opt-in and has only been applied/verified at Blackpine.

issues.title: Corner, floor/wall and wall/roof light bleed
issues.affected: Previously reported joins; broader map set unverified
issues.symptom: User reports light bleed through floor/wall joins and requests corner and roof intersection coverage.
issues.cause: Multiple possible causes: zero-depth geometry, open seams, normals, endpoint sampling or lighting occlusion; do not assume one cause for every join.
issues.action: Audit each surface and circuit pairing using MAP_FITNESS_CHECKLIST.md; log each reproducible location as a linked issue.
issues.evidence: BlackpineLightingTest covers selected wall/floor rays; LightingOcclusionRepairTest covers selected castle planes. These do not certify all corners/roofs.
issues.older_maps: All prior maps require a documented join/corner/roof sweep and matched light-state captures.

issues.title: Black and gray striped procedural metal
issues.affected: Twelve original working-place models plus mill suspension
issues.symptom: Metal developed regular dark/light bandage-like stripes.
issues.cause: Fixed-amplitude sine rows and bright border strips in the procedural metal shader.
issues.action: Rebuilt the working-place family with restrained proportional non-directional patina; suspension uses the corrected material.
issues.evidence: development/levels/MILL_REFINEMENT.md; validate_mill_expansion.py and validate_mill_lighting.py independently inspect packed row contrast below 2.5%.
issues.older_maps: Other historical model families require regeneration, source/hash updates and in-room inspection before being called corrected.

issues.title: Workshop bandsaw used as primary sawmill machine
issues.symptom: Small workshop saw did not fit the logway or sawmill purpose in the supplied reference.
issues.cause: Wrong machine type/scale for processing full logs.
issues.action: Added circular headrig aligned to the log carriage; relocated the small bandsaw to the repair shed.
issues.evidence: BlackpineMillExpansionTest; native blade/log/arbor and bearing checks in validate_mill_expansion.py.
issues.older_maps: Check purpose and human/material scale whenever industrial models are reused.

issues.title: Timber rack intersects ledger table
issues.symptom: Initial rack placement overlapped an existing furnishing.
issues.cause: Bounds were not separated in the first candidate placement.
issues.action: Moved the rack to X60.4/Z20.75; retain source bounds and measured room coordinates.
issues.evidence: BlackpineMillExpansionTest independently checks solid furnishing separation; MILL_REFINEMENT.md records the rejected placement.
issues.older_maps: Run furniture/furniture and furniture/wall checks for all old room kits; tabletop items need actual support-part checks.

issues.title: High mill worklights lack appropriate physical supports
issues.symptom: Worklight arrangement needed real roof attachment and a below-deck fixture.
issues.cause: Ceiling-origin fixtures must be supported at their authored height, not floated or floor-normalized.
issues.action: Added ceiling plates, suspension rods, crossbar, junction and protected electrical drop; corrected under-loft mount after slab addition.
issues.older_maps: Inspect brackets, fixture backs and circuit access at every older site.

issues.title: Added slab blocks final stair approach
issues.affected: Blackpine mill stair; introduced during DEV-001 fix
issues.symptom: BlackpineGrayboxTest failed at ascent step 113 immediately after adding slab collision.
issues.cause: The swept capsule overlaps the final riser before its feet reach landing height.
issues.action: Allow only an authored stair-to-slab landing contact within 200mm of the top and at the actual ramp elevation; other slab edges remain opaque/solid.
issues.evidence: BlackpineGrayboxTest failed before transition correction and passes afterward; swept route test still reaches all 15 zones over 292910 positions.
issues.older_maps: Every structural-depth retrofit must recheck both stair directions and landing transitions.

issues.title: Castle sky variation assertion fails on existing main
issues.symptom: CastleHubIntegrationTest fails its sky color-variation assertion.
issues.cause: Reproduced on unchanged main db9bb0d during branch unification; not attributed to new map assets.
issues.action: Keep open for renderer owner; do not suppress the assertion to claim a full green release.
issues.older_maps: Recheck when the responsible renderer change lands; do not silently drop this known failure.

issues.title: Slow software-renderer capture frames
issues.symptom: Capture logs report slow scene assembly/raster frames.
issues.cause: Target-hardware/native OpenGL behavior is not established by headless captures.
issues.action: Retain timings and profile native gameplay before claiming acceptable performance.
issues.older_maps: Measure each site on target hardware; do not copy a performance claim from another map.

audit_categories: Corner, floor/wall, wall/wall, wall/roof and roof intersection light bleed
Floor depth, underside normals, exposed edges and cut openings
Models in walls/roofs, furniture overlaps and blocked routes
Objects floating, sinking or incorrectly stacked on desks/shelves/counters; actual support-part bounds
Fixture attachment, pipes/cables, circuit and physical interaction access
Incorrect model purpose/scale, UV and texture defects
Any newly added/discovered development error, including regressions caused by fixes
